headline: Microsoft plans to let Copilot use the files on your Windows PC and take actions for you.
score_reason: Pool 8, kept: a large platform change announced 7 Oct; features not live yet.
importance_line: It matters most to Windows users, because Copilot would be able to reach their files and act on them when the feature is switched on, but so far the evidence is one video demo at a Microsoft event.
summary: The Verge reports that Microsoft demonstrated its Autopilot AI agent finding a user's tax papers in folders on a PC, renaming and zipping them, and drafting an email to the accountant. Microsoft says the abilities, called Hybrid Intelligence, mix AI that runs on the PC with cloud AI and will reach its Copilot assistant over the next couple of months.
